opening.argument: The observable content is chart-based investment analysis: the speaker identifies a personal NEAR accumulation zone of $1.60-$2.40 and a $1.40 stop loss, then sets staged take-profit levels from $3.30 through $19. Those targets are presented alongside a downside case, including a re-test of $1.00 support, and a stated condition that would change the thesis: "Sustained breakdown below $1.40 combined with declining on-chain metrics." citations.quote: My accumulation zone spans $1.60-$2.40. Stop loss for short term positions sits at $1.40.
My take profit targets… $3.30 first. $5 at triangle resistance, $6.90 at the 786 extension, $12 at the 1618, and $19 as my moon bag near the 2618 level.
What changes my thesis? Sustained breakdown below $1.40 combined with declining on-chain metrics.
Never financial advice, and I'll see you in the next one.
